requestClassification.basis: Each of the 15 successful UI cases recorded one generic ERR_FAILED console message and one blocked POST to the first-party /cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/ endpoint. These requests were generated automatically; the read-only guard aborted them. No application mutation, page error or HTTP resource failure was recorded. This is classification of existing evidence; the already-passing UI cases were not rerun.

visualReview.result: The CHARIZZMA five-person public release credit and recognition-only caveat are readable, with no member score editor. BEWAVE shows 725 and single-week lower-bound scope with retained teal layout. Browser assertions separately checked all 15 layouts.
